record: JOB 2 — layer-permutation null for the §7.3 two-block (tuning-shift) structure, rerun on the 100T layer-correlation matrices. Per dispatch DISPATCH_LEDGER_COMPUTE_L18_AND_PERMUTATION_100T.md.
LABEL: Descriptive support (SR.7). The split SEARCH guarantees some gap; this null quantifies the search artifact and does not grade the structure. It may not re-grade a registered verdict.
estimator_fix: Add-one form p=(1+count)/(B+1) applied UNIFORMLY to all three sizes, resolving the HA-era inconsistency where 2B used the plain 15/2000 form. Count reported alongside every p so the estimator is checkable.
procedure: Input: the per-size layer_corr_matrix from fixed_probe_tuning_shifts_100T_results.json (values rounded to 3dp as stored). block_split (scripts/.../fixed_probe_tuning_shifts.py, verbatim): best contiguous split s in [2,L-2] maximizing within-block minus cross-block mean off-diagonal correlation. Layer-permutation null: relabel layers by a random permutation pi, form C[pi][:,pi], rerun block_split, record the best gap; B=2000 permutations; count = number with gap >= observed; p = (1+count)/(B+1); null_max = max permuted gap. Seed numpy.random.default_rng(20261007), STATED here because the HA-era run's seed was never recorded in the ledger.
DEFINITION_FLAG: The HA-era permutation procedure is NOT serialized in the repo; only block_split is. This null is defined here as [permute layer labels, rerun block_split], the natural reading of 'layer-permutation null'. The Ledger should confirm this matches the §7.3 claim's intended null before the footnote-1 caveat is dropped. If the intended null permuted something else (e.g. correlation values), say so and this reruns.
search_artifact_gap_note: Observed gaps are large (0.39-0.62). The permutation null's gaps (the gap the split search manufactures from the same values in random layer order) are reported per size as null_mean/median/max. Whether the '<=.04 search-artifact gap bound' holds depends on which null statistic that bound referred to; the HA-era note is superseded, so the bound is reported here against the 100T null statistics for the Ledger to map.
